V Training and evaluation protocol V-A Source partition and selection All 271,010 training patches from centres 0, 3 and 4 enter every epoch. Validation uses 24,982 patches from three other source patients; 40,004 patches from three further source patients form the internal test. Centres 1 and 2 supply the two external hospital tests. Centre 1, used as out-of-distribution validation in the official WILDS protocol, is treated solely as evaluation here. Hence this study is not an exact official-leaderboard reproduction. The original training patient IDs are retained; label-blind alternating assignment of the remaining sorted source patient IDs gives the validation and internal-test partitions. All patient IDs and image ordering are frozen before training. Historical project use of these public targets makes the evaluation an exploratory replication; no target outcome selected the current objective, checkpoint, temperature or review threshold. V-B Models and optimization CNN is a from-scratch ResNet18 [ 33 ] : a 7 × \times 7 stride-two stem, four residual stages of widths 64/128/256/512 with two blocks each, global average pooling and a two-class linear readout.

Our compact ViT [ 34 ] partitions the image into 144 non-overlapping 8 × \times 8 patches, projects each 192-value RGB patch to width 128, adds a class token and learned positions, and uses four pre-normalized blocks with eight attention heads, GELU, width-256 feed-forward units and dropout 0.1. Layer normalization and a two-class head read the class token. V-C Full-source fits Each of six recipes is trained for 16 epochs with seeds 11, 29 and 47: 18 complete fits. AdamW uses learning rate 0.003 for EF and 0.001 for CNN/ViT, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient norm clipping at 5, and cosine decay to 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Effective batch size is 64; EF accumulates two 32-image microbatches, while CNN/ViT use 64. Unweighted cross-entropy retains the actual source class distribution. A whole-patch quarter-turn/reflection is sampled for each effective batch; paired EF receives a further independently sampled geometric transform. Its label-preservation assumption is a registered stress assumption rather than a guarantee about all pathology transformations. V-D Objectives and temperature Single-view EF uses cross-entropy; paired EF averages cross-entropy over two transformed views. Probability-regularized EF adds 0.05 0.05 symmetric KL, and signed-evidence EF further adds 0.02 0.02 normalized aligned all-class spatial-evidence distance. All four share the same learned architecture and parameter count. Training relaxation is 0.03 ​ max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − e / 12 ) 0.03\max(0,1-e/12) , floored at 0.01 for paired recipes. Every epoch evaluates hard source logits. Checkpoints maximize source AUROC, breaking ties by lower stable cross-entropy and then earliest epoch. The EF headline recipe maximizes mean three-seed source AUROC, with mean cross-entropy as tie-break; it is paired cross-entropy. Four EF recipes versus one per comparator is an unequal family search budget, so single-view EF and all objectives are also reported.

V-E Prediction, uncertainty and review An immutable 18-fit checkpoint lock precedes target inference. Each of 54 model/seed/pool prediction files is freshly reproduced and bound to image, patient, label, checkpoint and normalization digests. Headline probabilities are arithmetic means of three raw seed probabilities; calibrated ensembles average probabilities after each seed’s source-only temperature. Temperature scaling [ 35 ] minimizes source cross-entropy over 41 log-spaced values in [ 0.25 , 4 ] [0.25,4] . Confidence cutoffs use source-validation quantiles for nominal 90/75/50/25% retention. Evaluation reports actual external coverage and retained error without choosing an external cutoff. Percentile intervals use 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap draws; paired differences share the same patient draws. All patches of each resampled patient remain together. Our compact ViT [ 34 ] partitions the image into 144 non-overlapping 8 × \times 8 patches, projects each 192-value RGB patch to width 128, adds a class token and learned positions, and uses four pre-normalized blocks with eight attention heads, GELU, width-256 feed-forward units and dropout 0.1. Layer normalization and a two-class head read the class token. VIII Conclusion and reproducibility EF combines learned structure with signed spatial classification. Its source-selected ensemble, with 10,550 parameters per member, exceeds the implemented CNN/ViT on both held-out centres. Patient uncertainty, calibration, costs and exploratory public-target history define that result’s scope. The reproducibility record retains preparation, 18 checkpoints/histories, source policies, 54 prediction receipts, statistics, frozen source and independently reconstructed programs. Code, the independent reader, configurations and a reproducible input are available at https://github.com/isararsiddique/evidence-field ; model states and hash-bound artifacts are available at https://huggingface.co/Isarar/Evidence-Field .
